_comment: Suggestions that were removed from the catalog on purpose.
A suggestion's uuid is how the app remembers that someone ticked it off, so
uuids normally must never disappear — tools/check_uuid_stability.py fails any
Sometimes a removal is genuinely correct: a vendor drops the setting entirely,
or the advice becomes wrong. Record it here and the check will allow it.
Do NOT list a uuid here just to rename a suggestion. Keep the uuid and change
the readable `id` instead — that is exactly what `id` is for.
